candidate.definition_en: A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي بيألف الموسيقى ويكتب الألحان، زي بيتهوفن أو عمر خيرت.

senses.definition_en: A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.
senses.definition_ar: الشخص الذي يؤلف الموسيقى ويكتب الألحان الموسيقية.

He is regarded as the greatest composer of his generation.
